summary: ```markdown # CLO 2025.1 - Object Window Adds Zipper ## Introduction This video introduces the relevant update of the chain in the CLO 2025.1 version. ## Previous Version Limitations In the previous version, when you needed to change the attribute of a 3D chain on a piece of clothing, you had to choose each chain one by one and modify them individually. ## New Chain Selection Card In the 2025.1 version, the object window has added a new chain selection card. This feature allows you to manage chains according to the sample and store and apply it to the entire chain. ### Accessing the New Chain Selection When you open the object window, you will see the new chain selection added. The operations related to the chain will now be controlled by this selection card. 1. Press the increase button in the upper right corner to create a new default chain pattern. 2. Apply the newly created chain to the clothing. ## Applying the Chain To apply the chain: 1. Select the 3D chain that you want to use in the 3D window. 2. Press the application button on the right side of the new chain in the object window to apply it. If you first select a chain, then click the application button in the upper right corner of the object window, a new default chain will be created at the bottom and applied directly to the selected 3D chain. ## Copying Chain Patterns The copy function allows you to duplicate a similar chain pattern. To use this feature: 1. Select a chain in the object window. 2. In the attribute editor at the bottom, you can modify the overall shape of the chain, including its basic information, type, and size. You will see the changes reflected in the corresponding chain in the 3D window. ## Modifying Chain Details While maintaining the overall shape, you can also select various components such as the editor, head, and chain details. - When you press and hold the head, chain, or stop component, the entire chain component will be selected. - Press and hold the button again to edit the object, which will select only a specific object. If the selected object is divided into two or more grids, you can press and hold the button again to select only a specific object. ### Editing Chain Size Click on the chain part again to edit the size of the chain separately. After modification, the chain component will be selected again, allowing you to press and hold the button to edit a specific material color, if desired. ## Unifying Modifications You can also unify modifications across the chain and cloth to modify the material color and other attributes, similar to previous operations. ## Saving Chain Patterns You can save the designed chain pattern as a ZPS format file for use in other projects. To save a chain: 1. In the object window, select the chain to be saved. 2. Click the save button at the top of the property editor to save the file. ### Reusing Saved Chains The saved ZPS chain file can be opened anytime using the button next to it and reloaded in other projects. To open another clothing project file: 1. In the object window, select the chain. 2. Find the open icon in the property editor and select the saved ZPS file. You will see the new sample in the chain selection card list, and it will also be applied to the 3D clothing chain. ## Managing Unused Chains Additionally, you can press and hold the right button on any unused chain in the object window to rename, delete, or reset it. This is an effective way to clean up the list by deleting all unused chains. ## Conclusion You can see the new sample in the object window, and it is also applied to the 3D clothing chain. This update enhances the efficiency and usability of chain management in CLO 2025.1. ```
